gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-heebo:

gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-karla:

gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-kufam: Expressive and commanding, Funnel Display keeps its c tips well apart and its strokes uniform. Kufam, drawn like neon tubing with generously open curves in e, handles the steady reading work.
